BiblicalUsage: After all Job lost was restored double, his third daughter is named Keren-happuch — horn of antimony, a name for beauty — alongside Jemima and Ketsiah. She is named once, at the end of the book, when the story turns to restoration.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the naming of Job's daughters at the end matters: God restores by name, and beauty returns after the ashes.
